text: ポケモン　リーグ　めざしてるのか！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows something going on now; here it is shortened to てる, as in casual speech. めざしてる = 'are aiming for'.

patterns.name: 〜のか
patterns.explanation: のか at the end, said as an exclamation, shows the speaker has just realised something. めざしてるのか = 'so you're aiming for it!'
